1.why: Clean sans-serif typeface is used throughout with comfortable letter and line spacing on all screens.

2.why: No italics or all-caps appear; instructions are short single sentences rather than dense blocks.

3.why: Layout is single-column, generously spaced and legible at mobile width with no horizontal overflow.

4.why: All instructions use plain, short phrasing such as 'Sign in first' and 'Enter the 6 numbers when you are ready'.

5.why: Verification-code field explicitly shows the placeholder example 'Example: 123456'.

6.why: No screen requires reading a long block of text; each step has only one or two brief sentences.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control is provided for any code; the only codes are short OTPs the user must type.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is offered on any screen.

9.why: Standard email and password inputs are present, so browser autofill and password managers are supported.

10.why: Step indicator and prominent blue primary button make the current step and main action clear.

11.why: Most screens focus on one action, yet the code-entry screen simultaneously offers Send code, Check code and Send a new code.

12.why: Green banners plainly confirm results, e.g. 'Signed in. Next, check it is you' and 'A code was sent'.

13.why: User can freely resend a code or retry entry via 'Send a new code' without penalty.

14.why: Error states the problem and fix neutrally: 'That code did not match. Check the 6 numbers or send a new code'.

15.why: Copy explicitly says 'Enter it when you are ready' and no countdown or expiry timer is shown.
